high_level_description: The image is a weather map showing a forecast for heavy rainfall in parts of India. The map uses various colors to indicate different levels of precipitation intensity: Green areas represent lighter rain. Blue areas indicate moderate rain. Purple areas show heavier rain. Red areas highlight extremely heavy rain. The map covers a region that includes parts of Karnataka and Kerala, with the coastline prominently displayed on the left side. The text overlay at the bottom of the image reads: "Extremely heavy rain warned for Coastal Karnataka, widespread over Kerala as monsoon awaits off coast.
